title: Turn a LinkedIn Profile URL into a Full Person Profile and a Work Email
summary: How go-to-market teams and their coding agents turn LinkedIn profile URLs into full person profiles (title, company, experience, education) and verified work emails with Cargo: three batch calls, list prices from code, misses free.
body_markdown:
**To turn a list of LinkedIn profile URLs into full person profiles and work emails for go-to-market work, run` linkedin.enrichProfile` over the URLs for the profile (0.25 credits each),` aiArk.enrichPerson` for the work email (0.1 credits, only when an email is found), then` waterfall.verifyEmail` on the emails you got back.**


The profile call returns the current title, company, full work history and education, but no email. The email call returns an email or nothing. Run both when you need every profile; run only the second when you only need the email. The steps below use the Cargo CLI, so a coding agent can run them end to end, and they are what the[enrich-linkedin-profile](https://www.getcargo.ai/skills/enrich-linkedin-profile) skill does.


## What 1.8M profile lookups show#


Cargo platform data, 90 days to Oct 16 2026:


Measure Value


` linkedin.enrichProfile` runs 1,824,331


Workspaces running it 190


Runs that returned a profile 93.6%


Runs that found nothing and were charged 0 credits on 100%


## The actions and what they cost#


Each price is the list price in credits from the action’s definition in Cargo’s code. The finders charge only when they return data;` waterfall.verifyEmail` charges for every address it checks.


Step Action Credits Record fields


Profile` linkedin.enrichProfile` 0.25` linkedinUrl`


Email, rung 1` aiArk.enrichPerson` 0.1` linkedinUrl`


Email, rung 2` findyMail.findEmail` 0.5` linkedinUrl`


Email, rung 3` FullEnrich.findEmail` 1` linkedinUrl`


Verify` waterfall.verifyEmail` 0.1` email`


A contact that goes through the profile, the first email rung and verification costs at most 0.45 credits. A new account starts with 100 free credits and no card, which covers about 220 contacts at that rate.


No URLs yet? Resolve them from names and companies with the[find-linkedin-url](https://www.getcargo.ai/skills/find-linkedin-url) skill first.


## Run it#


### 1. Install and sign in


shellscript


```text
npm   install   -g   @cargo-ai/cli
cargo-ai   login   --email   you@company.com                   # sends a code
cargo-ai   login   --email   you@company.com   --code   123456     # creates the account on first use


```


There is no browser step, so a coding agent can run this itself.


### 2. Pilot the profile call on 5 rows


` --limit 5` submits only the first five records, so you can read the output and the cost before the full run.


shellscript


```text
cargo-ai   orchestration   action   execute-batch   \
--action   '{"kind":"connector","integrationSlug":"linkedin","actionSlug":"enrichProfile"}'   \
--records   '[{"linkedinUrl":"https://www.linkedin.com/in/example"}]'   \
--limit   5   --wait-until-finished


```


Drop` --limit` to run the whole list. The examples on this page leave out the` connectorUuid` an action object may carry, in which case Cargo uses the workspace’s default connector for that provider.` cargo-ai orchestration action list enrich profile` shows the action objects and their prices without running anything.


### 3. Find the work email


shellscript


```text
cargo-ai   orchestration   action   execute-batch   \
--action   '{"kind":"connector","integrationSlug":"aiArk","actionSlug":"enrichPerson"}'   \
--records   '[{"linkedinUrl":"https://www.linkedin.com/in/example"}]'   \
--wait-until-finished


```


Download the results with` cargo-ai orchestration batch download --uuid <batch uuid>` , keep the rows that came back without an email, and send only those to` findyMail.findEmail` , then` FullEnrich.findEmail` . The record shape stays` {"linkedinUrl": "..."}` on every rung. Never send the full list to every rung: a second provider charges again for an email already found.


### 4. Verify the emails


shellscript


```text
cargo-ai   orchestration   action   execute-batch   \
--action   '{"kind":"connector","integrationSlug":"waterfall","actionSlug":"verifyEmail"}'   \
--records   '[{"email":"ada@example.com"}]'   \
--wait-until-finished


```


Unlike the finders,` waterfall.verifyEmail` charges for every address it checks. The[verify-email-list](https://www.getcargo.ai/skills/verify-email-list) skill covers it in full.


## What comes back#


` linkedin.enrichProfile` returns one flat record per profile:


Group Fields


Person` full_name` ,` first_name` ,` last_name` ,` headline` ,` about` ,` location` ,` city` ,` state` ,` country` ,` linkedin_url` ,` public_id`


Current role` job_title` ,` company` ,` current_company_join_month` ,` current_company_join_year` ,` current_job_duration`


Company` company_domain` ,` company_website` ,` company_linkedin_url` ,` company_industry` ,` company_employee_count` ,` company_employee_range` ,` company_year_founded` ,` hq_city` ,` hq_country`


History` experiences\[\]` (` title` ,` company` ,` start_year` ,` end_year` ,` is_current` ,` description` ),` educations\[\]` (` school` ,` degree` ,` field_of_study` )


Reach` follower_count` ,` connection_count` ,` skills\[\]` ,` languages\[\]`


The email actions return:


Action Email Notes


` aiArk.enrichPerson`` email.output\[0\].address` AI Ark’s person record comes with it


` findyMail.findEmail`` email`


` FullEnrich.findEmail`` most_probable_email`` most_probable_email_status` , and` emails\[\].status`


` waterfall.verifyEmail`` email`` email_status` (` valid` when deliverable)


` aiArk.enrichPerson` treats a profile with no email as a miss: it returns no data and is not charged. That is why the profile call comes first when you need a profile for every row.


` cargo-ai orchestration action get-output-schema --action '<action object>'` prints any action’s output schema without running it.

## Frequently asked questions#


No. It returns the profile, current role, company, work history and education. Get the email with aiArk.enrichPerson, findyMail.findEmail or FullEnrich.findEmail, all of which take the same LinkedIn URL.


No. An action that finds nothing returns no data, and no credits are charged. In Cargo platform data for the 90 days to Oct 16 2026, 100% of the linkedin.enrichProfile runs that found nothing were charged 0 credits. waterfall.verifyEmail is the exception: it charges for every address it checks.


No. Cargo runs these actions on its own keys and bills credits. Nothing signs in to LinkedIn as you.
